elements.name: Collapse and expands the origin branch

steps.name: an active part in the MCAD Software contains a visible solid and has a visible model browser
the Origin branch is expanded
the branch shows three origin planes, three origin axes and a center point
the user clicks the Origin branch expansion control
the origin children are hidden
the Origin branch remains visible
the solid remains visible in the viewport
the user clicks the Origin branch expansion control again
the origin planes, axes and center point are visible again
the solid remains in the same apparent view

elements.name: Collapse and expands a feature branch

steps.name: an active part in the MCAD Software contains a visible block made by an extrusion with a nested sketch
the extrusion branch is expanded in the model browser
the user clicks the extrusion branch expansion control
the sketch row is hidden and the extrusion row remains visible
the block remains visible in the same apparent view
the user clicks the extrusion branch expansion control again
the sketch row appears beneath the extrusion
the block remains visible in the same apparent view

elements.name: Collapse and expands all browser branches

steps.name: an active part in the MCAD Software contains a visible block made by an extrusion
its browser has expanded representation, origin and extrusion branches
the user opens the model browser menu and chooses Collapse All
the top-level branches remain visible with their children hidden
the block remains visible in the same apparent view
the user opens the model browser menu and chooses Expand All
the origin planes and the nested extrusion sketch are visible
the block remains visible in the same apparent view

elements.name: Collapse and expands descendants of the solid bodies folder

steps.name: an active part in the MCAD Software has one solid body made by an extrusion from a sketch
the Solid Bodies folder shows the body, its extrusion and nested sketch
the user right-clicks Solid Bodies and chooses Collapse All Children
the body row remains visible under the folder
the extrusion and sketch rows under the body are hidden
the solid remains visible in the viewport
the user right-clicks Solid Bodies and chooses Expand All Children
the body's extrusion and nested sketch rows are visible again
the solid remains visible in the same apparent view
